HookEvidence.description: The exact retained accepted procedure and its full request/result. Each stage covers every selected dataset exactly once, allowing independently selected multi-dataset procedures. Procedure bytes and all result artifacts remain in custody. The owner independently matches procedures to accepted release/Plan authority and verifies artifact bytes before success; copying a procedure into this result does not grant execution authority.

cleanup.description: State at immutable drill completion. Retained means isolated resources remain under their original holds and custody; it cannot assert absence or discharge obligations. Complete requires independently checked native cleanup evidence. Later cleanup produces separate evidence rather than rewriting this result.

DrillResult.description: Immutable completed app.drill evidence required before a succeeded Operation can settle. Owner, operation_id, request_id, plan_digest and resource equal the exact producer; digest(checkpoint) equals its original reviewed arguments.checkpoint. The historical checkpoint owner remains unchanged even when a newly authorized drill owner or epoch differs; the receiver separately authenticates historical evidence and current recovery custody. The embedded checkpoint remains byte-for-byte unchanged: no restore-tested field is added or refreshed. The independently reviewed Plan pins the original checkpoint, production and isolated target bindings and complete accepted restore/verify procedure scope, with their reviewed isolation requirements. Actual native isolation evidence is produced and verified during execution and retained before success; the Plan need not predict the digest of that future output. Target and production native incarnations differ; this structural distinction alone never proves native isolation, which the receiving owner verifies across writers, credentials and endpoints. Every selected dataset has successful restore and verify-restore evidence for the same original Snapshot, joined to the parent operation and historical release. Every hook request and result also binds the isolated target's exact stable runtime_binding_digest; a different target path or production invocation cannot supply that evidence. Mandatory checks cannot be omitted or downgraded. Complete hook result/artifact custody and native isolation are established before success. evidence_closure retains the checkpoint and its recovery closure, stable binding digests, isolation/cleanup evidence, each accepted procedure/request/result and all artifact identities. completed_at is drill observation time only, not captured-data time; it cannot refresh RPO. Cleanup state is independent of verification success and never implicitly discharges retained resources. Exact replay returns this result and the original checkpoint unchanged.
